newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine fiscal revenue up 7.2 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Argentine fiscal revenue up 7.2 pct in July.

text.p: Argentina's tax revenue collected in July rose 7.2 percent from the same month a year earlier to $4.15 billion, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
The government said earlier in the week it expected tax collections to have grown 15 percent in July from a year earlier.
Analysts polled by Reuters forecast collections at $4.25 billion.
If private pension funds income is included, revenue increased by 9.9 percent to $4.58 billion in July from July 1996.
Value added tax collections in July were up 1.1 percent to $1.65 billion while income tax revenue advanced 6.3 percent to $593 million.
A month earlier tax revenues rose 6.2 percent from the same month a year earlier.
